page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r7.6xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 24 dedicated physical cores on an x86_64 architecture, utilizing the Intel Xeon 8369B processor operating at a base frequency of 2.7 GHz. The instance is configured with 192.0 GB of RAM, providing a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core. It does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, relying instead on network-attached storage and offering a baseline network bandwidth of 12 Gbps.

Benchmark evaluations place the ecs.r7.6xlarge in the average performance tier for most compute and memory operations. It achieves a Geekbench multi-core score of 11384.0 and a Passmark CPU score of 29229.28. Memory performance is characterized by a read-only large block bandwidth of 129.12 GB/sec and a write large block bandwidth of 62.93 GB/sec. Notably, the instance demonstrates strong performance in small-model LLM text generation, reaching 283.7 tokens per second with a 135M parameter model, while maintaining average speeds of 14.18 tokens per second on a larger 7B model.

Given its dedicated Intel Xeon processor cores and substantial memory capacity, this instance offers a balanced cost-to-resource profile for memory-intensive workloads that do not require local NVMe storage. The absence of bundled local storage means storage costs are decoupled, allowing for flexible scaling of network volumes. The ecs.r7.6xlarge is well-suited for database operations, in-memory caching systems like Redis, enterprise applications, and moderate data processing tasks.
